name: spellkave_query
label: Query Manifest / Definitions
description: Read the authored world — merges the former spellkave_manifest_inspect + spellkave_lookup, plus the #1968 definition-lookup gap's missing single-row detail/ref-traversal capability, into ONE tool. Dispatch is inferred from which fields you pass (no mode flag): omit `kind` for a workspace/target summary (bundle ids + row-kind -> count map); pass `kind` alone (or with `pattern`) for a bounded catalog list (default ids-only; add fields:'preferred' or fields:[col,…] to project extra scalars — e.g. entities preferred yields name+place_node_id for who-is-where in one call); pass `kind` + `id` for the complete authored row, its source, and (by default) its outbound/inbound refs — chase a ref by re-calling this tool with its own {kind, id} (e.g. a capability -> its affordance_templates -> their action_definitions -> outcome_templates). Sources, in order: the workspace scratch manifest, plus the active connection-level `target` when wired, or the legacy live `context.db` when no target is configured (result.source says which). Offline with neither, this is workspace-only. `target` overrides the source for THIS call only (read-only — write verbs offer no such override).

source_id.description: The `source.source_id` of the response that returned `ref`/`within`. Required with `ref` and `within`; another source, world or connection is refused.

facets.description: Summary only: include definition counts by kind and detailed authored tag facets. Default false; the compact summary offers this as a follow-up.

view.description: Summary/search/neighbors only. Default objects: instance bodies once, without tag rows. Explicit kind selects rows. Use rows for the technical inventory.

tags.description: Summary: count these literal tags separately on definitions and distinct objects. Search: require all tags. Tags are never inherited from definitions.

fields.description: search/detail only: scalar names from the collection schema for search, or the selected row kind's schema for detail; `label` is also selectable.

limit.description: Page size. Default 12 tag facets for summary, 5 for search (ranked: label equals, starts with, contains, then other text), 20 otherwise.

explore.description: Bounded admitted discovery. Summary inventories all three collections with coverage and per-kind counts (incomplete kinds are lower bounds). Instance summary/search count objects once by default; view rows preserves technical rows and explicit kind selects rows. Defaults to live; search collection follows kind, otherwise unrestricted text searches all collections and empty text defaults to places. An explicit collection must agree with kind. Explicit workspace/local source is never unioned. Follow exact returned references; no read grants write permission.

kind.description: A manifest row-kind name (a ROW_KIND_NATURAL_KEY key — e.g. 'capability_definitions', 'affordance_templates', 'action_definitions', 'outcome_templates', 'entity_definitions', 'area_shape_definitions', 'resource_definitions'), the SAME vocabulary spellkave_write_rows and every define_* verb already use — not a closed enum. Also accepts a `*_tag` satellite kind (e.g. 'resource_definition_tag', 'capability_definition_tag') — these have a TWO-field composite key (parent id + tag) instead of a single natural key; see `schema: true` for the field order. Omit for a workspace/target summary (bundle ids + a row-kind -> count map) instead of listing one kind.

id.description: An exact natural-key value within `kind` — returns the complete authored row (detail shape), its source, and (by default) its refs. For a composite-keyed `*_tag` satellite kind, this is its ordered key fields' values joined by '::' (e.g. 'srd/wis::ability_score' for resource_definition_tag's `{resource_definition_id, tag}` — get the exact ids from a `kind`-only list call first). Mutually exclusive with `pattern`; requires `kind`.

pattern.description: A substring filter on `kind`'s ids (its natural-key value, or its '::'-joined composite-key value for a `*_tag` satellite kind) — returns a filtered list instead of the full catalog. Mutually exclusive with `id`; requires `kind`.

bundle.description: Restrict to rows stamped with this bundle_id (summary/list shapes only).

fields.description: List shape only (`kind` without `id`; ignored for detail/summary/schema). Default (omit): token-safe catalog — each item is only `{ id, bundle_id? }`. `preferred`: project a small kind-specific field set (e.g. entities → name, place_node_id, kind, entity_def_id) so one list call can answer who-is-where without N detail round-trips. Explicit string[]: project exactly those column names from each row (unknown/missing names omitted; nested values skipped). `id` is always present; `bundle_id` is included when the row has it.

refs.description: Detail shape only (`kind`+`id`; ignored otherwise). 'outbound': fields on this row pointing elsewhere (already-computed string-ref heuristic). 'both' additionally computes inbound_refs — every OTHER row anywhere in the resolved source whose own outbound ref points AT this row, grouped by referencing kind — so a caller traverses a chain (e.g. capability -> affordance -> action -> outcome) by re-calling spellkave_query with a ref's own {kind, id}, no separate traversal tool needed. Default: 'both' when `id` is set.

target.description: #1968 connection-level target override (READ-only — no write verb offers this): 'workspace' reads ONLY the workspace scratch manifest, ignoring any connection-level target/live db this call would otherwise consult. 'local' reads ONLY the active local folder target — errors if none is configured. 'live' reads ONLY the active live target (or the legacy live db when no target is wired at all) — errors if neither is available. Omit for the default union: workspace + whatever is configured (result.source says which).

schema.description: Ask what a row of `kind` may CONTAIN instead of which rows exist (#1983): with `kind`, that row kind's required fields, field types, and natural/composite key; without `kind`, the row-kind vocabulary itself (every kind the manifest schema defines, flagged for whether this tool can also list its rows). Schema covers all 79 manifest row kinds — a superset of the ~53 `id`/`pattern` can address: the 40 with a single-column natural key, plus the `*_tag` satellite kinds and `tag_capability_grant` with a two-field composite key (finding #9; sk-bwd). Ignores `id`/`pattern`/`bundle`/`target`: a row kind's shape is the same everywhere, so no source is consulted.

promptSnippet: Inspect authored/live rows and definitions by kind and id, or list what exists
promptGuidelines: Use spellkave_query before spellkave_write_rows or a define_* verb to confirm an id doesn't already exist, or to check whether a referenced niche_id/capability_id/entity_def is already authored.
Call spellkave_query with kind+id to fetch one row's full detail and inbound/outbound references — chase a reference by re-calling spellkave_query with the ref's own {kind, id}.

Place graph + who-is-where: spellkave_map_graph, then spellkave_query kind=entities fields=preferred (group by place_node_id). Default list is ids-only — request fields when you need columns. Deeper playbook: spellkave_docs doc=place-graph-occupancy (only if needed).
